decisions_log.summary: Measured the over-assignment, then hit a blocking finding the plan did not anticipate.
decisions_log.over_assignment: 2,445 of 2,778 elements carry imports; 11,578 entries attached; in ALL 203 files that have imports every element carries a byte-identical copy of the whole-file list.
decisions_log.measured_consequence: clones.ts:247 triviality: 193 elements qualify today, 1,264 would qualify under per-element imports. 1,071 elements are wrongly excluded - a live wrong answer, 6.5x.
decisions_log.blocking_finding: element.imports[].specifiers/.default/.namespace are NEVER populated. relationship-extractor.ts:1106 looks up import_clause via childForFieldName, which tree-sitter-typescript returns NULL for; the raw-facts path at :467 already works around exactly this and documents it in a comment. The block at :1120-1144 is dead code. Proven at grammar level on identical source.
decisions_log.consequence_for_the_plan: P1-T3 cannot pick the planned narrowing rule: matching an element body against import specifiers requires specifiers, and there are none. HALTING to report per P1-T3 rather than silently re-scoping the phase.

decisions_log.why_a_ruling_was_needed: The measured baseline showed the planned rule was unimplementable: there are no specifiers to match against. Options were put to the operator rather than re-scoped silently.
decisions_log.rule: keep an import on an element when any bound local name appears as a whole word in the element body span
decisions_log.error_asymmetry: false keep = harmless (status quo); false drop = data loss. Rule errs toward keeping.
decisions_log.honest_limit: text heuristic, not symbol resolution - comments/strings can cause a false keep, dynamic access can cause a false drop

decisions_log.summary: Phase 1 complete. The repair turned out to be THREE instances of one lookup defect, not one.
decisions_log.what_widened: P1-T6 first ran 8/10 green: specifiers worked but default and namespace did not. Same root cause one level deeper - childForFieldName("name") also returns null for the default binding and the namespace alias. Fixed by mirroring extractRawImports:494-499 and :515-522 rather than inventing a third approach.
decisions_log.revert_proof: 8/10 fail at HEAD; the 2 passers are the conservatism guards, which is the correct shape.
decisions_log.suite: 2637 -> 2647 passed, 33 skipped, zero regressions. populate-cli.test.ts fails identically before and after (pre-existing beforeAll tsc hook timeout).
